real_qa.q: Why did the host of Be a PROFITABLE Badass Small Business Owner Podcast put the show on pause after 740 episodes?
real_qa.r: The host realized after 10 years that something had to give because of multiple personal and professional demands. Family responsibilities increased significantly, including caring for parents before they passed and now taking in a mother-in-law with dementia, while simultaneously running two businesses working 60-80 hours a week. The host decided to pause the podcast to free up time for creating training videos and tools to help small business owners understand P&Ls and financial reports at a deeper level.
real_qa.requete: Be a PROFITABLE Badass Small Business Owner Podcast 740 episodes pause

real_qa.q: What are the main reasons small business owners failed after the 2008 financial crisis according to the Be a PROFITABLE Badass Small Business Owner host?
real_qa.r: Small business owners failed primarily because they were not profitable before the crash and had no contingency plan. Those who did not understand their business numbers made poor decisions and threw away money without knowing if they would get a return. Many exhibited victim mentality, blaming the economy instead of pivoting their business model. Owners who survived were those with money in the bank, little to no debt, who pivoted their services when customer demographics changed, and who paid attention to profitability rather than just top-line sales.
real_qa.requete: small business owners failed 2008 crisis financial collapse reasons

real_qa.q: What is the three-bucket sales growth model explained by the Be a PROFITABLE Badass Small Business Owner host?
real_qa.r: According to the host, sales growth comes from three buckets: you can increase your new customers, you can get your existing customers to come back more often, or you can increase your average ticket price per transaction. This concept has remained the same for 40 years and is universal across all businesses regardless of industry.
real_qa.requete: three buckets sales growth new customers repeat average ticket

real_qa.q: When did the Be a PROFITABLE Badass Small Business Owner Podcast originally launch and what was its initial name?
real_qa.r: The Local Small Business Coach Podcast launched on September 24th, 2016. It was originally called that because the host intended to coach small business owners. The show later morphed into Be a PROFITABLE Badass Small Business Owner after the phrase resonated strongly with listeners and aligned with the host's core message about helping business owners become profitable.
real_qa.requete: Local Small Business Coach Podcast September 24 2016 launch

real_qa.q: What business experience did the host of the Be a PROFITABLE Badass Small Business Owner Podcast have before starting the podcast?
real_qa.r: The host spent 22 years at Home Depot working up to managing million-dollar stores and million-dollar districts before leaving corporate America in 2008. After that, the host became a small business owner, initially purchasing and running a local ice cream shop. Before starting the podcast, the host had been an unofficial coach to various small business owners for five to six years, combining experience from both Home Depot management and personal business ownership.
